subject: Preprod's sign-in page shows no OAuth buttons: auth.spec.ts:24 fails on every deploy and the cause is unmeasured
activeForm: Finding why preprod's sign-in page renders no OAuth buttons

origin.evidence: deploy run 38086859278 on main 38f5a225: 31 passed, 1 failed, frontend/tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts:24 'should show OAuth buttons'

work_items: Card #27: measure why preprod's /auth/signin renders no OAuth buttons, fix the cause, and verify on the Amplify URL

description:
Target: Customer Dashboard (Next.js/Amplify).

MEASURED. The preprod Playwright suite fails 'should show OAuth buttons' (frontend/tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts:24); deploy run 38086859278 on main 38f5a225 had 31 passed and that 1 failed. AGENTS.md records missing OAuth buttons as a real bug that shipped while test-preprod could not fail. Card #17 showed the cause is NOT the stale unit tests it fixed: the sign-in page (frontend/src/app/auth/signin/page.tsx:38-50) renders buttons only for the providers returned by GET /api/v2/auth/oauth/urls (src/lambdas/dashboard/auth.py:1662), and distinguishes 'fetch failed' from 'zero providers configured' since feature 1373.

UNMEASURED, the first step. What preprod's /api/v2/auth/oauth/urls returns today: an error, an empty providers map, or providers the page then fails to render. Each points at a different fix: CORS or routing, missing provider configuration (Cognito identity providers or secrets, which may be an operator action and may not be a code fix at all), or the page.

CONSTRAINTS. Verify on the Amplify URL (PREPROD_FRONTEND_URL), never the Lambda. If the fix needs a new AWS resource or a secret value, stop and ask the operator.
